Commit-reveal spot audits bound to a future randomness beacon.
Each identity escrows collateral on a five-tier terrace ladder (2-16 units) and files a salted work-log hash. Ninety minutes later the zephyr beacon publishes VRF randomness picking 5% per epoch for karst probes: checks of the revealed log versus chain receipts, plus one 30-second live reply; failure burns the deposit.
N=100 sybils deposit 1000 units but earn 0.50 each per epoch; probes burn 5 x 10 = 50 units per epoch, so gains never beat losses; honest identities keep deposit and rewards.
